import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] inputLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int p_input = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[0]);
        int k_input = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[1]);
        final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007L;

        if (k_input == 0) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p_input, p_input - 1, MOD_CONST));
        } else if (k_input == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p_input, p_input, MOD_CONST));
        } else {
            List<Integer> divisors = findDivisors(p_input - 1);
            for (int div : divisors) {
                if ((p_input - 1) % div == 0 && modPow(k_input, div, p_input) == 1) {
                    long result = modPow(p_input, (p_input - 1) / div, MOD_CONST);
                    System.out.println(result);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static List<Integer> findDivisors(int n) {
        Set<Integer> result = new HashSet<>();
        int candidate = 1;
        while (candidate * candidate <= n) {
            if (n % candidate == 0) {
                result.add(candidate);
                result.add(n / candidate);
            }
            candidate++;
        }
        List<Integer> sortedResult = new ArrayList<>(result);
        Collections.sort(sortedResult);
        return sortedResult;
    }

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
